customerId.description: The 10-digit Google Ads account id to query, e.g. 1234567890 (dashes allowed). Under a manager account this is the client account, not the manager.

geoTargetConstants.description: Geo targets as resource names or bare ids (e.g. geoTargetConstants/2840 or 2840 for the US). Repeatable. Omit for all locations.

includeAdultKeywords.description: Include adult keywords in the results.

language.description: Language as a resource name or bare id (languageConstants/1000 or 1000 for English). Omit for all languages.

loginCustomerId.description: Manager (MCC) account id, sent as the login-customer-id header. Required when the account is accessed through a manager account.

pageSize.description: Max ideas to return per page.
